scope: Exact OE/supplier application evidence and catalogue-conflict notes only in product applications arrays.

records.name: Taper Roller Bearing 30204
records.note: Bearing-source reconciliation (Delta Bearing Co. Tata application table, exact standard bearing designation 30204; Tata Genuine OE reference 269533403101): Delta lists 30204 for Tata Ace front-wheel inner position and Tata 1512 water-pump application. The Souviks record is a 30204 taper-roller bearing and the exact OE number is independently identified as a Tata taper-roller bearing, but the catalogue currently tags Tata 1109, 1210, 1312 and 1512. This source supports only its stated Ace/1512 uses; it does not substantiate every current model tag. Match the bearing designation, cup/cone set, position and physical dimensions to the axle/pump before supply. Sources: https://www.deltabearing.com/application/21/bearings-for-tata.html ; https://www.bpautosparesindia.com/oem-detail/TA164DLX/

records.name: Engine Overhaul Seal Sub-kit
records.kind: OEM part description; chassis fitment not listed
records.note: Tata e-Dukaan exact-reference confirmation (Engine / Gasket category, part 278801990103): Tata lists this part as “SUB KIT-SEAL ENG.OVERHAUL”. This establishes the genuine part description and engine-overhaul function; the viewed e-Dukaan listing does not identify a chassis/model fitment. The current Ace/Magic vehicle tags are therefore not independently confirmed by this listing; verify the vehicle-specific engine overhaul kit and pack marking before supply. Source: https://newui.edukaan.tatamotors/spare-parts/engine/eng-gasket-tata

records.name: Air Filter Element BS 2/3/4
records.note: Independent OE cross-reference conflict (WIX MHIN PC WIX Picture Catalogue, February 2023, exact OE 278809130114): WIX lists air filter WA11253A for Tata Ace Magic. This differs from the Souviks current 1109/1210/1312 application note and needs VIN/engine reconciliation; do not assume the WIX cross-reference proves interchangeability across those medium/heavy vehicle models. Match the filter shape, sealing face, dimensions and engine intake before supply. Source: https://www.pssao.com/catlog/mf/MHIN%20PC%20WIX%20Picture%20Catalogue%20Feb%202023%20without%20CAF-2.pdf

records.name: Assy. Crankshaft Gear
records.note: Tata manufacturer-parts-manual evidence (Tata Motors Indonesia, Super Ace Euro-II DLE, VC 28187824000R, Group 00 Engine / Drive Parts; exact part 279005110107): listed as “ASSY GEAR (FOR CRANKSHAFT) (SINTERED)” for the Super Ace 475 IDI TCIC engine. This source supports the crankshaft-gear component description and Super Ace Euro-II engine assembly, but not the current broad Ace/Magic tags for every engine variant. Confirm engine code, timing gear tooth/module and physical marking before supply. Source: https://tatamotors.co.id/old/wp-content/uploads/2017/03/SUPER-ACE-DLE.pdf

records.name: Timing Belt
records.note: Independent Tata parts-catalogue cross-check (P14 / Indigo-Dicor parts catalogue, Engine Timing Parts, exact part 254705116312): listed as a Gates GD100 timing belt, “Chassis Type: ALL” within the Indigo-Dicor catalogue. The Souviks current application note separately cites Tata commercial-vehicle brochure evidence for 407/709/1109. These sources identify different vehicle contexts; do not use the P14 Indigo-Dicor entry to expand truck fitment or to discard the separate commercial-vehicle evidence without exact engine/OE validation. Confirm belt tooth count, profile, length, engine family and pack marking. Source: https://www.tatamotor.com.pl/file/catalogues-p14-indigo-dicor.pdf

records.name: UJ Cross 42 x 129
records.note: Secondary exact-code U.J.-cross cross-reference (MOD Plus UJ Cross Finder, code 4054BP2): listed for Tata 1613 Turbo and 2515 HYWA, RSB type / RSB 403 (single-roller), 42 × 129 mm. This provides a specific driveline-series and dimension reference; the current broad Tata LPT tag is not by itself proof for every LPT configuration. Verify cup diameter, cross length, bearing style and shaft series before supply. Source: https://www.modspareparts.com/post/uj-cross-part-number-finder-match-your-vehicle-to-the-right-cross

records.name: UJ Cross 48 x 135

records.name: UJ Cross 41.28 x 125.90
records.kind: secondary exact-code driveline application / tag limitation
